findings.title: StringIndexOutOfBoundsException when start + end exceeds string length
findings.body: The diff-display logic at line 111 computes `start` (matching prefix length) and `end` (matching suffix length) independently, but does not guard against `start + end > value.length()` or `start + end > sanitized.length()`. For example, if `value = "aa"` and `sanitized = "aaa"`, then `start = 2` and `end = 2`, making `value.substring(2, 2-2)` throw `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException` because the begin index exceeds the end index. This will crash the verifier on certain inputs where one string is a prefix-extension of the other.

findings.title: Italian text mistakenly placed in Lithuanian translation file
findings.body: The value `totpStep1=Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` is Italian, not Lithuanian. This appears to be a copy-paste error introduced by this PR when replacing the previous HTML-containing Lithuanian translation. The same issue exists in `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties` at line 71 (`loginTotpStep1`). Lithuanian users will see Italian text.

findings.title: Regex character class `[a-zA-Z-_]` includes unintended characters due to range interpretation
findings.body: In the regex `_[a-zA-Z-_]*\\.properties`, the sequence `Z-_` inside the character class is interpreted as a range from `Z` (0x5A) to `_` (0x5F), which includes `[`, `\`, `]`, and `^`. While unlikely to cause issues with real file paths, the intent was clearly to match locale codes (letters, hyphens, underscores). The hyphen should be placed at the start or end of the class, or escaped: `[a-zA-Z_\\-]`.

findings.title: santizeAnchors uses replaceFirst on modified string but matcher iterates original
findings.body: In `santizeAnchors`, the `matcher` is created from the original `value` string, but `value` is reassigned via `replaceFirst` inside the loop. If the same anchor tag text appears multiple times in the value, `replaceFirst` will remove the first occurrence in the current (possibly already modified) string, which may not correspond to the occurrence the matcher is currently pointing at in the original string. This could lead to incorrect stripping when duplicate anchor tags exist.

findings.title: Non-static instance fields POLICY_SOME_HTML and POLICY_NO_HTML are re-created per instance
findings.body: `POLICY_SOME_HTML` and `POLICY_NO_HTML` are instance fields (not static, not final) but are immutable policy factories that could be shared. They use ALL_CAPS naming convention suggesting they should be constants. Making them `private static final` would avoid unnecessary re-creation and clarify intent.
